# ScriptTaskContext

[API index](../index.md)

Runtime context for one admitted script task run.

Game actions submit existing native tasks and await their result. Terminal or stale contexts
reject new work; normal HTN priority controls when an operation executes.

**@keywords**

task, context, htn, input, cancellation

## MoveToGrid

```typescript
MoveToGrid(Destination: Vector2, ArrivalRadiusGrid: number): Promise<void>;
```

Moves through the native pathfinding stack until reaching the grid destination radius.
Uses the normal movement goal and replanning policy; higher-priority HTN work can suspend it.

**@keywords**

task, movement, pathfinding, grid, navigation

## InteractEntity

```typescript
InteractEntity(Target: Entity): Promise<void>;
```

Waits for the existing native entity interaction task to complete.
Completion reports the action result, not a verified change in the game.

**@keywords**

task, entity, interact, input, click

## ClickElement

```typescript
ClickElement(Resolve: () => Element | null, Modifiers?: ScriptMouseModifiers | null): Promise<void>;
```

Resolves a fresh UI element and waits for the native click task with optional modifiers.
Missing targets use the native click readiness timeout; verify the game result separately.

**@keywords**

task, element, ui, click, input

## WaitUntil

```typescript
WaitUntil(Predicate: () => boolean, TimeoutMs?: number | null): Promise<void>;
```

Waits while the synchronous predicate is false and resolves when it becomes true.
An omitted timeout waits until cancellation; timeout values are nonnegative milliseconds.
This is an HTN operation: suspension pauses its timeout. The predicate is synchronous and read-only.

**@keywords**

task, wait, predicate, timeout, polling
